load_config_from_yaml: load a YAML config file and convert it into a typed dataclass instance using OmegaConf
dump_config_to_yaml: dump a dataclass config object to a YAML file with optional logging of the config contents
convert_dict_to_dataclass: convert a dictionary to a dataclass instance by merging override values into a structured base
convert_dataclass_to_dict: convert a dataclass instance to a plain dictionary with all nested structures resolved recursively
flatten_nested_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into a single-level dictionary using underscore-separated compound keys
